{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = df.dtypes

# Check unique values in customer_segment
unique_segments = df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check conversion rate by segment
total_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment').size()
converted_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_by_segment = converted_by_segment / total_by_segment * 100

# Output results
missing_values, dtypes, unique_segments, conversion_rate_by_segment"}
